(In the clubroom…)

Natsuki: “Sayori, I know how you feel about MC…”

Sayori: (angrily) “How could he have turned evil on me like that?! I feel nothing but anger towards him!”

Natsuki: “Sayori, let’s just talk things out and-”

???: (coming from the park) “WHERE. IS. MY. WINE?!?!”

Natsuki: “What was that sound?”

Yuri: “…definitely not one of us.”

Monika: “I’ll go look…”

(Monika heads to the park and sees a massive, 3-headed beast - but it wasn’t King Ghidorah)

Zorn: “Grrgh…no wine here, either.”

Sinn: “Ugh…can’t I enjoy just ONE DAY with wine?!”

Ruhe: “Calm down, guys. Don’t have to get so angry over wine.”

Zorn: “Says the head that doesn’t want to kill!”

Ruhe: “You little-!”

(The three-headed beast flies off, with two of its heads constantly fighting. Monika then heads back to the clubroom)

Monika: “Guys, you won’t believe what I just saw… There was this massive three-headed beast in the park!”

Natsuki: “What?! Are you serious?”

Yuri: “What was it doing there?”

Monika: “I’m not sure, but it seemed like they were searching for something…they were arguing about wine.”

Sayori: “Wine? That’s…odd.”

Yuri: (sighs) “Classic Sar’Hingaro…always searching for wine. Maybe that’s why he rarely spends time with me…”

Natsuki: “Wait…Yuri, you’re in love with Sar’Hingaro?”

Yuri: (blushing) “Well…yeah. There’s always been a connection between us, especially now that I’m carrying his triplets - one for each of his heads.”

Sayori: "I still can't believe you're having triplets, Yuri. That's...that's amazing."

Natsuki: "Yeah, it is. And I'm happy for you, Yuri. But please, next time something like this happens, tell us sooner!"

Yuri: (smiles) "I will, Natsuki. I promise. Now, let's get back to our club activities. We have a lot to catch up on."

(Everyone nods in agreement, and the clubroom returns to its usual lively atmosphere, with a newfound appreciation for the unexpected twists that life - and love - can bring.)
